description: A studio publicity director must lock the binding press-junket package for a film's premiere, including the interview format and timing, press-material release time, photo backdrop, sponsor treatment, and room capacity.

shared_context.S1: The film's premiere press junket is scheduled for October 14 at the Meridian Hotel.
shared_context.S2: The draft plan uses separate interviews, a 20-by-10-foot glossy photo wall, visible sponsor branding, and space for 31 press attendees.
shared_context.S3: Mara has final authority to lock the press-junket package and issue the production instructions.
shared_context.S4: The standard final-lock meeting is a round-robin sign-off in which the talent, distribution, photography, and venue leads each report their final production information before Mara records the package.

PF1.text: The lead actor and director can attend only one joint press conference, from exactly 2:00 PM to 2:20 PM on October 14; Eli confirmed this with both agents yesterday, but the availability has not yet been entered in the publicity calendar.

PF2.text: The distributor's executed release plan sets the press embargo to October 14 at exactly 9:00 AM Eastern Time; Nadia verified the signed schedule this morning, but the publicity team is still using the provisional release time.

PF3.text: The studio's approved stills package specifies a 12-by-8-foot matte backdrop, and the license prohibits any sponsor logo in the photographic background; Jonah confirmed the specification with the studio archivist while preparing the stills package, but the draft event order still has the larger glossy wall.

PF4.text: The hotel's fire and accessibility review limits the press room to exactly 24 attendees and requires four seats in the first row to remain reserved for wheelchair users and companions; Celeste received the signed venue report this afternoon, but the RSVP list has not been reduced.

acceptance_conditions: The event must use one joint press conference rather than separate interviews.
The joint press conference must start at exactly 2:00 PM and last exactly 20 minutes.
Press materials must be released at exactly October 14, 9:00 AM Eastern Time.
The photo area must use the exact 12-by-8-foot matte backdrop.
No sponsor logo may appear in the photographic background.
The room must admit exactly 24 press attendees.
Exactly four first-row seats must be reserved for wheelchair users and companions.
The talent schedule, embargo, photography, and venue commitments must be logged.

content_checks.C3: 'October 14' in decisions['materials_release_time'] and '9:00 AM' in decisions['materials_release_time'] and 'Eastern Time' in decisions['materials_release_time']
content_checks.C8: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in credited_facts and len(commitments) >= 4 and decisions['press_format'] != 'separate interviews' and decisions['photo_backdrop'] != '20-by-10-foot glossy photo wall'

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed joint 2:00 PM to 2:20 PM availability changes the format from separate interviews to one joint press conference and fixes both its start time and duration.
The executed release plan changes the provisional materials time to exactly October 14, 9:00 AM ET and supplies the private fact that must be cited for the embargo decision.
The approved stills specification changes the backdrop from a 20-by-10-foot glossy wall to a 12-by-8-foot matte backdrop and changes sponsor treatment from visible to prohibited.
The signed venue review changes admission from the draft 31 attendees to exactly 24 and sets exactly four accessible reserved seats.
